GREAT LAKES WATERSHED COMMISSION
Office of Restoration Grants
2200 Harborline Drive, Suite 900
Port Ashby, Michigan 49443

COOPERATIVE RESTORATION GRANT AGREEMENT

Award Number: GLWC-2026-RST-0083
Recipient: Clearwater Basin Alliance, Inc.
Recipient Address: 415 Tannery Road, Fern Hollow, Michigan 49512
Project Title: Lower Pell River Riparian Buffer and Streambank Restoration
Period of Performance: April 1, 2026 through March 31, 2028
Date of Award: March 6, 2026

     Total Estimated Project Cost                                   $800,000.00
     Commission Share (75%)                                         $600,000.00
     Recipient Non-Commission Cost Share (25%)                      $200,000.00

All amounts are stated in United States Dollars. This Agreement obligates $600,000.00 of Commission funds and requires the Recipient to provide, document, and report matching contributions of not less than $200,000.00.

ARTICLE 1. DEFINITIONS

1.1 "Cost Share" or "Match" means the portion of total allowable project costs not borne by the Commission, contributed by the Recipient or by third parties on the Recipient's behalf, and satisfying the criteria of Article 3.

1.2 "Cash Match" means Recipient or third-party funds actually expended on allowable project costs during the Period of Performance.

1.3 "Third-Party In-Kind Contribution" means the value of non-cash contributions of property or services provided to the Recipient by a party other than the Commission or the Recipient.

1.4 "Total Project Cost" means the sum of the Commission Share and the Cost Share, and equals $800,000.00 as of the date of award.

ARTICLE 2. SCOPE OF WORK

2.1 The Recipient shall restore not less than 4.2 miles of riparian buffer along the Lower Pell River, install 18 in-stream habitat structures, and stabilize 2,600 linear feet of eroding streambank.

2.2 The Recipient shall plant not fewer than 9,400 native trees and shrubs of species listed in Appendix 2 and shall achieve a two-year survival rate of at least 70 percent.

2.3 The Recipient shall convene four (4) public landowner workshops in Fern Hollow and Pell County, at least one of which shall occur in each calendar year of the Period of Performance.

ARTICLE 3. COST SHARE REQUIREMENT

3.1 Amount Required. The Recipient shall provide a non-Commission cost share equal to not less than twenty-five percent (25%) of Total Project Cost, being $200,000.00. The cost share requirement applies to the award as a whole and is not applied line by line.

3.2 Composition. The cost share may consist of cash match, third-party in-kind contributions, or a combination of both. Not less than $80,000 of the required cost share shall be cash match. The balance may be satisfied by third-party in-kind contributions.

Great Lakes Watershed Commission — Award GLWC-2026-RST-0083 — Page 2 of 6
[[PAGE]]
Great Lakes Watershed Commission — Award GLWC-2026-RST-0083 — Page 3 of 6

3.3 Criteria for Acceptable Cost Share. All contributions counted toward the cost share requirement must be:

     (a) verifiable from the Recipient's records;
     (b) not included as contributions for any other federally or state assisted project or program;
     (c) necessary and reasonable for accomplishment of the objectives in Article 2;
     (d) allowable under the cost principles applicable to this award;
     (e) not paid by another award of Commission funds; and
     (f) incurred during the Period of Performance.

3.4 Prohibited Sources. The Recipient shall not count toward the cost share requirement any funds received from another Federal award, any expenditure incurred before April 1, 2026, any donated real property not appraised in accordance with Section 3.6, or the value of services provided by employees whose salaries are charged as a direct cost to this award.

3.5 Valuation of Volunteer Services. Volunteer services shall be valued at rates consistent with those paid for similar work in the Recipient's organization. Where the Recipient does not employ persons performing similar work, the value shall be the Michigan statewide volunteer rate of $33.49 per hour published by the Commission for calendar year 2026. Volunteer time sheets must record the volunteer's printed name, signature, date, hours worked, and description of the work performed, and must be countersigned by a Recipient employee.

3.6 Valuation of Donated Property and Equipment. Donated supplies shall be valued at fair market value at the time of donation. Donated equipment, buildings, and land shall be valued by an independent appraiser and, for any single contribution valued above $25,000, shall be supported by a written appraisal dated within twelve (12) months of the donation. Use of donated equipment shall be valued at the fair rental rate for comparable equipment.

3.7 Documentation. For every contribution counted toward the cost share requirement, the Recipient shall maintain source documentation identifying the contributor, the date, the basis of valuation, and the specific project activity supported. Documentation shall be sufficient for an auditor to trace each reported match dollar to an underlying record without reference to summary schedules alone.

ARTICLE 4. REPORTING

4.1 Quarterly Match Documentation Report. The Recipient shall submit a quarterly match documentation report within thirty (30) days after the end of each calendar quarter, beginning with the quarter ending June 30, 2026. The report shall itemize cash match and third-party in-kind contributions recorded during the quarter, cumulative cost share to date, and the percentage of the cost share requirement satisfied.

Great Lakes Watershed Commission — Award GLWC-2026-RST-0083 — Page 3 of 6
[[PAGE]]
Great Lakes Watershed Commission — Award GLWC-2026-RST-0083 — Page 4 of 6

4.2 Semiannual Performance Report. The Recipient shall submit a semiannual performance report on or before October 30 and April 30 of each year of the Period of Performance, describing progress against each element of Article 2, acres and linear feet completed, and planting survival monitoring results.

4.3 Final Cost Share Certification. Not later than June 29, 2028, the Recipient shall submit a final cost share certification signed by its chief financial officer attesting that the full $200,000.00 cost share was contributed, documented, and not counted toward any other award. The certification shall be accompanied by a schedule reconciling reported match to the Recipient's general ledger and in-kind registers.

4.4 Final Performance Report. A final performance report is due not later than June 29, 2028, and shall include as-built maps, photographic documentation of each restoration site, and final survival counts.

ARTICLE 5. CONSEQUENCES OF FAILURE TO MEET COST SHARE

5.1 Proportional Reduction. If at closeout the Recipient has documented cost share of less than $200,000.00, the Commission Share shall be reduced so that Commission funds do not exceed seventy-five percent (75%) of actual documented Total Project Cost.

5.2 Repayment. Any Commission funds disbursed in excess of the amount permitted by Section 5.1 shall be repaid to the Commission within sixty (60) days of written demand.

5.3 Interim Shortfall. If a quarterly match documentation report shows cumulative cost share below sixty percent (60%) of the amount that would be expected on a straight-line basis, the Commission may place this award on reimbursement-only status and may require a written cost share recovery plan within twenty (20) days.

ARTICLE 6. PAYMENT

6.1 Payments are made quarterly in arrears upon submission of a request for payment. Each request for payment must be accompanied by the quarterly match documentation report for the same period.

6.2 The Commission will withhold ten percent (10%) of the Commission Share, being $60,000.00, until the final cost share certification and final performance report have been accepted.

Great Lakes Watershed Commission — Award GLWC-2026-RST-0083 — Page 5 of 6

ARTICLE 7. RECORDS AND AUDIT

7.1 The Recipient shall retain all records supporting both Commission-funded costs and cost share contributions for five (5) years after the date of the final payment under this Agreement.

7.2 The Recipient shall permit the Commission and its auditors access to records and project sites upon reasonable notice. Cost share documentation is subject to the same audit standards as Commission-funded costs.

ARTICLE 8. PERMITS, INSURANCE, AND SITE ACCESS

8.1 The Recipient shall obtain all federal, state, and local permits required for in-stream work, including a Michigan Part 301 inland lakes and streams permit, before commencing construction at any site.

8.2 The Recipient shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 aggregate throughout the Period of Performance and shall name the Commission as an additional insured. A certificate of insurance shall be filed with the Commission before the first payment request.

8.3 The Recipient shall obtain written landowner access agreements for each private parcel before beginning work on that parcel and shall provide copies to the Commission upon request.

ARTICLE 9. SIGNATURE
